latin: Sicut primus intellectus inter omnes intellectus primo se intelligit, alia secundario, ita ultimus intellectus inter omnes intellectus primo alia a se, et seipsum secundario intelligit.
translation: Just as the first intellect, among all intellects, understands itself first and other things secondarily, so the last intellect, among all intellects, understands things other than itself first, and itself secondarily.
